title: 第13章 无伤获得第一笔启动资金
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
下午六点，干完活的荣华还有松松，各自抱着一堆芒果站在城主府门口。

    花期正在总结进度，两人一鼠摘完了芒果，还开荒了一亩半的地，大家表现都不错。

    说到最后她说了句让她们明天准时来，便让一人一鼠早点回去。

    松松双手抱着芒果，嘴里还含着一嘴的花生米。

    “再见大人，明天俺会准时来，谢谢大人您的食物。”

    它对花期甩了甩尾巴，马上跳下台阶消失不见。

    花期对它挥挥手，说了声再见，转身打开一箱营养液，从里面挑了三支原味的营养液递给荣华。

    “给，今天食物不多，这些是你今日的酬劳。”

    荣华正要和花期告辞，一听她这样说赶紧拒绝。

    “大人，这使不得，酬劳您已经给我了，这些珍贵的水果都够一个月的酬劳。”

    花期微微一笑，将营养液放进她撩起的衣襟里。

    “拿着吧，它们也是食物，一口管饱和水差不多，你带回去不容易被别人发现。”

    荣华神魂一震，双眸中难以掩饰她的震惊，“真的吗大人，喝了一口就能管饱？”

    “对的，所以我让你拿着，以后你那边方便了可以打包食物，不方便就打包营养液。”

    荣华眼眶一热，颔首致谢：“多谢大人。”

    “快走吧，早点回去休息，干了一天活回去还要走路很累的。”

    花期也对她挥挥手，转身回到城主府。

    大门缓缓在荣华面前关闭，她不再犹豫，心中默念树林，下一秒便消失在古城。

    ......

    天色渐黑，花期洗漱完躺在卧室的大床上，只觉哪哪都痛。

    身上像是被拖拉机碾压过，从头到脚连至骨头缝都在痛。

    她呈大字型张开腿，忍着肌肉酸痛打开一下午都没看一眼的终端。

    一点开，无数条消息和电话传进来。

    花岁岁的委屈语音，花家两个老东西的指责，还有打不通电话的花言脑残发来的威胁消息。

    【你是不是还不长教训，赶紧给妹妹道歉，不然我要你好看】

    【花期，赶快给岁岁道歉，不然你以后别想回我们花家】

    【我怎么生了你这么一个恶毒的女儿，早知道你性格如此恶劣，当年还不如让你死在荒星】

    几十条消息，全是对花期的谴责，没有一条消息是询问她到底干了什么。

    又是这样，这几个脑残从来都是这样。

    每次花岁岁哭了或者受委屈了，这几人问也不问，直接上来大肆辱骂花期，丝毫不找她求证一番。

    在花家人心里，她干什么都是错，在家里呼吸是错，花岁岁喝水呛到了也是她的错。

    这些人，每天的口头禅便是‘道歉’、‘给岁岁道歉’、‘闭嘴’、‘混账’、‘你还想解释啥’。
content_en:
At six o'clock in the afternoon, Ronghua and Songsong finished their work, each holding a pile of mangoes and standing at the door of the city lord's mansion.

    During the flowering period, we are summarizing the progress. Two people and one mouse have finished picking mangoes, and they have also cleared an acre and a half of land. Everyone is doing well.

    At the end of her speech, she asked them to come on time tomorrow, and then asked one person and one mouse to go back early.

    Songsong held the mango in both hands and had a mouthful of peanuts in his mouth.

    "Goodbye, sir. I will come on time tomorrow. Thank you for the food, sir."

    It flicked its tail at Hua Qi and immediately jumped down the steps and disappeared.

    Hua Qi waved to it, said goodbye, turned around and opened a box of nutrient solution, picked out three bottles of original nutrient solution and handed them to Ronghua.

    "Here, there isn't much food today. This is your reward for today."

    Ronghua was about to say goodbye to Huaqi, but when he heard what she said, he quickly refused.

    "Sir, this is impossible. You have already given me the reward. These precious fruits are enough for a month."

    Hua Qi smiled slightly and put the nutrient solution into her lifted skirt.

    "Take it, they are also food, a tube full of water is about the same. You will not be easily discovered by others if you take them back."

    Rong Hua's soul was shaken, and her eyes could not conceal her shock, "Is it true, sir, that you can be full after just one sip?"

    "Yes, so I let you hold it. In the future, you can pack food if it's convenient for you. If it's not convenient, pack nutrient solution."

    Ronghua's eyes heated up and he nodded in thanks: "Thank you, sir."

    "Come on, go back and rest early. You will be very tired after working all day and walking back."

    Huaqi also waved to her and turned back to the city lord's mansion.

    The door slowly closed in front of Ronghua. She no longer hesitated, thinking about the woods silently in her heart, and disappeared into the ancient city in the next second.

    ...

    It was getting dark. After washing up, Hua Qi lay on the big bed in the bedroom, feeling pain everywhere.

    My body felt like it had been run over by a tractor, and there was pain from head to toe to the bones.

    She spread her legs wide open and endured the sore muscles to open the terminal that she hadn't looked at all afternoon.

    As soon as I opened it, countless messages and phone calls came in.

    Hua Suisui's voice of grievance, the accusations from the two elders of the Hua family, and the threatening messages from Hua Yan, a mentally retarded person who couldn't get through on the phone.

    [You haven’t learned a lesson yet, apologize to your sister quickly, otherwise I want you to look good]

    [Hua Qi, apologize to Suisui quickly, otherwise you won’t be able to return to our Hua family in the future]

    [Why did I give birth to such a vicious daughter like you? If I had known you had such a bad character, I might as well have let you die on the Desolate Star]

    Dozens of messages were all condemning Hua Qi, and none of them asked what she had done.

    It's like this again, these idiots have always been like this.

    Every time Hua Suisui cried or felt wronged, these people would come up and insult Hua Qi without asking any questions, without asking her for confirmation.

    In the hearts of the Hua family, everything she did was wrong, breathing at home was wrong, and it was also her fault that Hua Suisui choked on the water she drank.

    These people’s daily mantras are ‘apologise’, ‘apologize to Sui Sui’, ‘shut up’, ‘bastard’, ‘what else do you want to explain’.
